Callout.Name: Multiple Casualties - Shots
Callout.Message: Two people shot in the street.
Callout.Advisory: One walking wounded, one on the ground.
Callout.Patient: I am fine. Help him first. Help him.

Lines.Approach: One walking and one not. The walking one is not the priority, whatever he says.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
